operations.summary: Replace OPM Designer instructions for a system
operations.notes:
GENERAL USE
1. Use the API '/securechange/tickets/{id}/steps/{stepId}/tasks/{taskId}/fields/{fieldId}/opm_designer/systems/{systemId}' to retrieve the designer results.
2. Run this API to modify the required instructions.

GENERAL NOTES
a. All instruction properties may be modified except the instruction ID, which is immutable.
b. Each request may contain one or more instructions; each instruction represents a single change operation (ADD, MODIFY, DELETE).
c. All referenced UIDs must already exist in the system.
d. All network related values: IP addresses, object types, service definitions and protocols, must be valid and logically correct from a networking perspective.


Instruction object notes:
a. The id field is mandatory and uniquely identifies the instruction and cannot be modified.
b. The change_type defines the type of action and must be one of the permitted values (ADD, MODIFY, DELETE).
c. The changed_entity object must always be included and defines the specific object being modified or created.
d. The relation_changes list must be present, and defines how entity relations will be updated.

ChangedEntity notes:
a. The type field is required and determines which entity subtype must be used (HOST, SUBNET, IP_RANGE, SERVICE types, RULE, etc.).
b. The uid is optional and used when modifying existing entities.
c. The new_entity_uid is optional and used when the system assigns a new UID.
d. The name is optional.
e. Additional required fields depend on the entity subtype (Host, Subnet, IP Range, Rule, Transport Service).

ChangedEntity subtype requirements:
a. Host: ip_type and ip are required.
b. Subnet: ip_type and ip are required, and one of netmask or cidr.
c. IP Range: ip_type, min_ip, and max_ip are required.
d. IP Service: min_protocol and max_protocol required.
e. ICMP Service: min_icmp_type and max_icmp_type required.
f. Transport Service: min_port, max_port, and protocol are required.
g. Rule: In case of a new rule, only the location field is required; the comment is optional.

RelationChange notes:
a. The relation_change_type is required and defines the type of change applied (ADD, MODIFY, DELETE).
b. The relation field is required and identifies the relation being updated (SOURCE, DESTINATION, SERVICE, MEMBER, SRC_ZONE, DST_ZONE).
c. The predefined_value is optional and used to set special values like ANY.
d. Both entities and embedded_entities must be present in the request (can be empty lists).

EntityReference notes:
a. The type and name fields are required to reference an existing entity.
b. One of the following must exist: uid or new_entity_uid.
c. The name field remains required for identifying the referenced entity.

RuleLocation notes:
a. The placement field is required and determines rule positioning (BEFORE, AFTER, LAST).
b. The other_rule_uid or other_rule_identifier may be used when placement is BEFORE or AFTER another rule.

EmbeddedEntity notes:
a. Embedded entities contain full object definitions used inside relation changes.
b. Each embedded entity requires a type and additional fields based on subtype.

Embedded entity subtype requirements:
a. Host: ip_type and ip are required.
b. Subnet: ip_type and ip are required, and one of netmask or cidr.
c. IP Range: ip_type, min_ip, and max_ip required.
d. Transport Service: min_port, max_port, and protocol required.
e. IP Service: min_protocol and max_protocol required.
f. ICMP Service: min_icmp_type and max_icmp_type required.
